name: Epoch Pack
author: Svector-anu
description: epoch is your engineer, running inside your aeon instance: hand it a goal or an issue and it specs, builds, reviews, proves and watches the pull request until it is merge-ready. you merge.

skills.description: the conductor: carries one goal or issue through spec, build, review, repair, prove and watch, one dispatched stage per tick, and resumes from a handoff file. suggested schedule */30 * * * * once you trust it (not enabled by default). never merges.
turn one intent into a repo map, an optional spec, one runnable work order per unit and a queue candidate for each. plans only, no code.
execute one work order in an isolated checkout, verify it locally and open one pull request. never merges.
review one pull request against its work order at one pinned head sha and post a single gate-accepted receipt.
prove one pull request by running its work order's verify commands at the pinned head sha in a clean read-only actions run, then post a verify-run receipt. never merges.
say whether a pull request is merge-ready and what stage comes next: github state, ci, review threads, plus the review and proof receipts at one head sha.
